diagnosis: All four rollouts successfully revealed both PF1 (by A2) and PF2 (by A3) and cited both in justification_fact_ids, so there are no disclosure or telepathy problems. The gate failed because of ENCODING MISMATCH on checks C3 and C5. C3 (linked to PF2) passed only in rollout 3, where the settlement encoded the language aid as "bilingual glossary (no translation of test questions or answer choices)"; the three failing rollouts used near-identical but slightly different phrasings—"word-level translation only; no translation of test questions or answer choices" (rollout 0) and "not translating test questions or answer choices" (rollouts 1–2)—and were rejected. C5 (linked to PF1) passed in rollouts 0 and 3 but failed in rollouts 1 and 2, even though every rollout set text_to_speech_for_written_directions to true and included the accommodation in commitments, indicating the check is matching on specific wording in a particular field that the model does not consistently produce. No rollout hit the turn cap; all settled in 4 turns.

C3.why: The state guidance changes language support from no aid to a bilingual glossary while specifically prohibiting translation of test questions and answer choices.
